name: Gemini Decisions API
desc: API that returns fast yes/no, choice and rubric-score decisions
desc_zh: 快速返回是非、选择和评分决策的 Gemini API
solves: Routing and checks used full text generation; this API scores up to 1,000 questions in one pass.
solves_zh: 路由和审核过去靠整段文本生成，这个 API 一次调用可评判上千个问题。
best_for: You triage support tickets by category and need a cheap first pass before an LLM call.
best_for_zh: 客服工单要先分类，想在调用大模型前做一层低成本的初筛。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：B — https://www.producthunt.com/products/google (maker page), then D: blog.googl）。 Powered by the Gemini Decision 1 model; reached through an API key in Google AI Studio. Product Hunt lists a launch on November 10, 2026; the official post is 2026-11-11. 首次公开日期来源：https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/gemini-decisions-api 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://aistudio.google.com/docs/decisions?auto_signin=false）。
